games.name: FNAF: The Original Trilogy Roleplay

Greetings, and welcome to FNAF: The Original Trilogy RP!
This roleplay game is a compilation of FNAF1, FNAF2 and FNAF3 packed into one single game.

FEATURES:
-Play as your favorite Five Nights at Freddy's characters ranging from Freddy Fazbear, Bonnie, Chica, Foxy, The Puppet, so many characters!
-Roleplay in your favorite locations from the games
-Badge Characters: There are badges hidden in different areas of the map, find their locations to unlock unique characters!
